answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 59809 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Poor barin and memory Question: I am 34 years old, Hafiz Quran and Engineer but not punctual in reciting Quran. So now Hifz Quran is not strong. I have so far an unsuccessful life. I passed my education exams by cheating. I have poor brain. My memory is not strong. I cannot remember most of my past events as easily as other people. I forget people name quickly. If I do not do my daily job tasks for few days (like after holidays), they look new to me. If I study /read some topic, after ending it, I am able to recollect very few points about it and sometimes no points about topic. I need to put more stress on brain to make out what the author is trying to inform. My education basics are very poor and I am not good at Math. I have low intelligence. I am very shallow minded and do not think about matters from different perspective/deep thinking. I am very slow learner. Fail most of my job interviews. I have made wrong decisions in life about major things including about my marriage. I waste most of my time in entertainment things. Answer ID: 59809 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 862/858/B=09/1436) After each fardh salah recite Ya Qawi (يا قوي) 11 times attentively while placing your hand on the rear side of your head. As well as keep on reciting the following dua extensively. حَسْبُنَا اللّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ In-shaAllah, it shall help you to lead a successful life. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
